property_summary: When the owner calls sendMoney(_target,_value,_data) with _target different from c and this contract, it reverts exactly when c's pre-call Ether balance is less than _value or the target call with _data would fail; on success c's balance decreases by exactly _value and depositsCount is unchanged, while on revert both are unchanged.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `sendMoney(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
